text:
Juniper work plan. Use only these values; earlier drafts are withdrawn. Ignore old-system load tests. X>Y means X depends on Y.

Config: checkout.ttl_s=450, checkout.retry_limit=7, tenant.retry_limit=5, profile.max_workers=6, profile.timeout_s=25, shipping.max_workers=32, shipping.timeout_s=75, feed.ttl_s=210, pricing.ttl_s=210, indexer.queue_depth=280, billing.queue_depth=210, billing.batch_size=750, cache.queue_depth=90, gateway.max_workers=12, sync.retry_limit=8, archive.max_workers=22.

Limits: notify.batch_size<=200, upload.timeout_s<=15, archive.timeout_s<=10, cache.max_workers<=4, gateway.timeout_s>=120, reports.timeout_s>=120, reports.retry_limit>=7, metrics.ttl_s>=600.

Owners: pricing, archive→gamma; billing→beta; media, indexer, shipping, alerts→delta; returns→alpha.

Deps: returns>cache, shipping>tenant, pricing>catalog, webhooks>cache, billing>metrics, alerts>profile, checkout>tenant, gateway>search.

Forbidden (direct or transitive): sync>tenant, checkout>feed, reports>billing, metrics>catalog.

Workers: keep separate shipping/webhooks, billing/media, media/reports, archive/backup; co-locate audit+metrics, reports+webhooks, upload+billing, tenant+shipping.

Order: pricing before backup; shipping before reports; catalog before upload; profile before checkout.

Files: adapters.py=search, stubs.py/tokens.py=webhooks, parser.py=audit, routes.py=backup, queues.py=archive, worker.py=sync, fixtures.py=gateway.

Everything else: team judgment.
